visualPresets.description: Dark gradient, cool cyan accents, restrained glow.
High-contrast rounded shapes and warm secondary accents.
Calm structured cards with low visual noise.
Non-geographic route diagram. Never substitutes for a real map.
Bar chart generated only from supplied numeric data.
Monospace code surface generated from supplied code.

audioPresets.description: Simple major-feeling procedural bed for summaries/outros.
Short impact for reveals and emphasis.
Noise/sine sweep for movement and transitions.

rules: Charts require supplied numeric values; never invent chart data.
Procedural maps are schematic routes only and require at least two supplied locations.
Generated SVGs are fallback/editorial graphics, not factual depictions of real people, products, places, or documents.
Prefer real evidence assets for claims that depend on a specific interface, document, product, or location.
